description: Exploratory within-episode transfer discovery; 14 mechanisms across H1/2/3 and J1/2/4/6/8/10, three development seeds. Frozen 575k return/return checkpoint; no claim of confirmatory selection or equal compute across H/J.

rho_a0_c0.description: Fresh pretrained actor and critic at every decision.

rho_a0_c05.description: Fresh actor; critic halfway between frozen prior and previous final critic.

rho_a0_c1.description: Fresh actor; full previous online critic.

rho_a05_c05.description: Half actor and half critic transfer toward frozen priors.

rho_a05_c1.description: Half actor transfer; full critic transfer.

rho_a1_c05.description: Full actor transfer; half critic transfer.

rho_a1_c1.description: Full actor and online critic transfer, fresh target from online and fresh Adam/replay/temperature.

behavior_only.description: Fresh learner actor and critic; fixed previous final actor collects imagined transitions. First decision uses ordinary fresh collection.

fresh_replay25.description: Fresh networks; 25% replay minibatch rows from the preceding solve, 75% from current solve.

joint_replay25.description: Joint weight transfer and 25% preceding-solve replay; fresh Adam/temperature and target copied from online.

full_state_replay25.description: Joint networks plus target critic, Adam, temperature and lifetime state; 25% preceding-solve replay. Outer world model remains frozen.

joint_prior_anchors.description: Joint weights with actor KL(current||frozen prior) coefficient 0.1 and critic normalized per-tensor prior MSE coefficient 0.1; denominator mean(prior tensor squared)+1e-6.
